title: CWP/11734/2025 of AMRITPAL KAUR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 129 Date of decision: 29.04.2025 Amritpal Kaur ....Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and Others ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present: Mr. Ankush Thakral, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Satnam Preet Singh, DAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (ORAL)

1. Learned counsel submits that even though the representation had been submitted, still the similarly circumstanced employees working with the petitioner have been surplused and adjusted vide order dated 20.09.2024, Annexure P-13, regarding which he would file a fresh representation stating all facts, which may be directed to be decided in a time bound manner, to which learned State counsel has no objection.

2. Disposed of accordingly. However, in case a fresh representation is filed within 4 weeks, the same be decided within a further period of 3 months from its receipt, in accordance with law. (AMAN CHAUDHARY) JUDGE 29.04.2025 Hemant
